---
name: Correction
about: Something on a page is wrong, or has changed in a newer patch
title: "[page-name] short description"
labels: correction
---

**Page**
Link to the page in `docs/` (or on the site).

**What it says**
Quote the sentence, table row, or code block.

**What you observed**
What actually happens. Include the patch level (e.g. Zurich P9, Zurich P10) and how you checked — Builder, DevTools, a table query, a REST call.

**Suggested fix** (optional)
If you know the right wording, put it here, or open a PR instead.
